brief:
Palestinians began returning to their Gaza camp on Thursday following Israel's military announcement that it had concluded a tank raid aimed at dismantling a suspected Hamas tunnel, according to Reuters. The operation marked the Israeli military's largest ground incursion into the camp in recent operations.

Residents surveyed widespread destruction across the area as families assessed damage to homes and infrastructure left by the armored assault.

title: Gazans return to ravaged camp after Israeli tank raid ends
